overview: The Sites and Replication exercise extended the existing domain with DC02. The retained work demonstrates additional domain controller promotion and a replication summary in the same lab subnet.
environment: DC01 and additional domain controller DC02
AD DS, DNS and Global Catalog

steps.title: Name the additional server
steps.description: I assigned DC02 its permanent lab name before promotion.

steps.title: Configure static addressing and DNS discovery
steps.description: I set DC02’s static address and pointed preferred DNS to DC01 so it could locate the existing directory services.

steps.title: Join the existing domain
steps.description: I joined DC02 to the domain and restarted it, then used an authorized domain administrative session for the remaining setup. Sign-in values are excluded.

steps.title: Install AD DS and select replica promotion
steps.description: I installed the AD DS role and selected Add a domain controller to an existing domain rather than creating another forest.

steps.title: Select DNS and Global Catalog capabilities
steps.description: I enabled DNS server and Global Catalog for DC02 and configured recovery access. The published options crop excludes recovery password fields.

steps.title: Select the initial replication source
steps.description: I chose Any domain controller as the initial replication source in the additional options.

steps.title: Review prerequisites and promote
steps.description: I reviewed the passing checks, started promotion and allowed the required restart and initial replication.

steps.title: Inspect the replication summary
steps.description: I ran repadmin /replsummary. The captured summary lists DC01 as a source and DC02 as a destination with 0 of 5 failures in each listed role.

checks.title: Additional domain controller setup
checks.description: The captures show existing-domain promotion, DNS and Global Catalog selection and passing prerequisites.

checks.title: Observed replication pair
checks.description: The summary shows zero failures for the displayed DC01 source and DC02 destination entries.

lessons: An additional domain controller joins the existing directory rather than creating another forest.
Correct DNS discovery is a prerequisite for joining and promotion.
A replication summary checks a point-in-time relationship; it does not establish failover behavior or every replication direction.
scope: The retained evidence covers one subnet and the displayed replication pair. It does not demonstrate a geographic site design, a cross-site schedule or a controlled domain-controller outage test.
